name: The Pattern Nobody Placed
purpose: A small grid of stones, shells and sticks across a page, where a visitor can drag pieces around to see if they line up into the hidden pattern Merge is convinced is there.
howItPlays: The visitor sees a pale island map covered in tiny dots, each one labeled with an object from the island. They drag the dots around, and whenever three or more line up, Merge's notebook in the corner writes a new entry, with a dry note like 'Found it again. Still not placed by anyone.' Lines drawn…
